reason: The hypothesis directly restates the core finding of P4 (and echoed in P34) that SRO roughens the energy landscape and increases strength via nanoscale detrapping, and proposes the same controlled thermal processing comparison already studied in P4 and P8. The addition of 'local shear-fault energy fluctuations' from P16 is a minor terminological update, but the overall idea, mechanism, and test are taken from a single line of work.
copied_elements: controlled thermal processing to promote/suppress SRO (P4, P8)
SRO creates rugged energy landscape and nanoscale segment detrapping (P4)
SRO increases strength relative to random solid solution (P4, P34)
falsification by comparing SRO vs. no-SRO samples (P4, P8)
use of NiCoCrFeMn as example alloy (general knowledge)
